result:
I added `GET /orders/:id` in `src/app.ts`, and the test suite passes, including a new test for the route.

It returns the order's `id`, `status`, `total_cents` and `created_at`, plus an `items` array. Each item has `product_id`, `quantity` and `price_cents`, ordered by `product_id`.

A missing order, another user's order, or a non-numeric or out-of-range id all return a 404. That 404 uses the existing error format with code `not_found`. I made other users' orders return 404 rather than 403 so the route doesn't reveal which order ids exist.

The new test in `test/app.test.ts` covers the owner getting 200 with an `items` array, another user getting 404, and a non-numeric id getting 404. It doesn't check item contents, because the seed data may have no order items. I didn't check.

I didn't update the Postman collection in `postman/`.
